description: r0b0tlab's preferred serve of its NVFP4 export of XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL on two GB10 Sparks: SGLang nightly 582389ce with tensor and expert parallel 2, Marlin MoE runner, calibrated FP8 KV cache, in-checkpoint EAGLE MTP (3 steps, 4 draft tokens), MiMo tool and reasoning parsers, and multimodal input (image; upstream also probed audio and video). Upstream default context 524,288 (model native 1M) with 8 running requests and a pinned 4096 draft window. Licences: r0b0tlab original work MIT, base model MIT, SGLang and the vendored patches Apache-2.0 (information only). Upstream claims +21% decode over the vendor MXFP4 checkpoint (median 69.1 vs 56.9 tok/s at bs=8); not measured here. The upstream DFlash lane is not selectable because options cannot remove the MTP arguments. Memory deviates from the creator's mem-fraction-static 0.90 (profiles/MTP-500k-mm.env @ 2852795b), which needs about 125.6e9 per Spark and is not admissible on two Sparks: this recipe uses 0.85 with a 524,288-token pool pinned by max-total-tokens. The creator ships 0.85 as precedent (profiles/W8.env @ 2852795b, MEMFRAC=0.85).
title: MiMo V2.6 Flash RL NVFP4 SGLang dual Spark (r0b0tlab)
